verdict.rationale: Meltano projects are plain YAML/config plus code, initialized via CLI (meltano init), plugin definitions live in the project file, and docs explicitly state you can treat the project like any software project with version control, code review, and CI/CD; it's self-hostable and portable via Docker. Community corroborates real-world production use (GitLab) and CLI-first, self-hosted nature. Missing for 10: independent case studies specifically about code review/PR workflows around Meltano projects beyond vendor docs.
